TokenBudgetBasis.node_purpose: Execute the five frozen DELL report-gap requests once through the current R39 local retrieval runtime and compile an auditable R11 clause-ownership, price-attachment and proof-aware transformation candidate ceiling that directly addresses the two fresh R10 findings without broadening source, ranking, Evidence, S2 or report authority.
TokenBudgetBasis.input_scale: Five unique requests; one local Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B query batch; each request must expose exactly 96 unique union and 16 unique final-review candidates over 1,888 source records and 34,199 compiled objects. Deterministic R11 classifies six targets, emits four-state ClauseOwnershipDecisions, requires one affirmative specific-product price attachment for ASP completion, and binds every complete source frame to a proof-equivalent compiled frame.
TokenBudgetBasis.required_outputs: Exclusive attempt receipt and raw execution capture; immutable PredicateFrames, ClauseOwnershipDecisions, ScopeEdges, ArgumentGroupBindings and PriceAttachmentProofs; per-role and per-proof lossless FrameTransformationBindings; per-target source/compiled/union/final counts and ranks; exact partial-family diagnostics and external/4B/reranker eligibility; digest-bound private/public results; and a redacted terminal-failure receipt on any post-consumption failure, with every downstream authority false.
TokenBudgetBasis.schema_burden: Bind 14 immutable inputs including R10 policy/public/private/attempt/raw, fresh R10 failure, fixed audit manifest, R17 report failure and exact 14-file carry-forward bundle; bind implementation commit/tree and 33 implementation hashes; enforce policy-only parent/path, canonical exclusive outputs, minimum disk, exact-once 5x96-to-16 ranks, raw-first capture, atomic pair rollback, zero-authority counters, exact replay/reprojection and threat-first public schemas.
TokenBudgetBasis.materiality_quality_risk: A false complete can merge an independent right-clause event into Dell, split a fronted adjunct as an owner, or associate a contract, maintenance, freight, financing or arbitrary nominal amount with a product that the source never priced. Losing an ownership or attachment proof during transformation can make a compiled frame appear semantically equivalent. Such errors corrupt residual-source, 4B/reranker, Evidence, S2 and later report decisions. Separately, forgetting the unchanged R17 failure would hide zero reader URLs, zero claim-passage bindings, incomplete crosswalk/WWC and missing human acceptance.
TokenBudgetBasis.comparable_run_evidence: Immutable R10 used the same five-request 96-to-16 chain and one local 0.6B batch, returning 338 unique union and 80 final candidates, but fresh review found exactly two P2 findings. R11 author gates passed 93 direct tests, 159 R10+R11 adjacent tests and 152 Project-OS/base-foundation tests; active baseline remained 213 Python/8 frontend/5 detectors/28 resources/0 forbidden, and the 8,211-file secret scan had zero findings. Zero-call preview took 44.022661 seconds and preserved every complete family, count, rank and downstream disposition while exposing partial-only proof-schema deltas.
TokenBudgetBasis.reasoning_profile: Non-generative deterministic clause-ownership, price-attachment and transformation-provenance compilation plus one local CUDA/FP16 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B query batch. Embedding supplies ranking only; R11 semantic admission is deterministic. No 4B embedding, reranker, generation model, Provider, external capture or network call is authorized; later mixed-model and reranker eligibility is measured only on a real changed candidate pool after independent pass.
TokenBudgetBasis.stop_and_truncation: Fail before consumption on disk, Git, exact parent/path, sync, predecessor/audit/R17 bundle, implementation binding, runtime, input, collision, policy digest or public-schema drift. After exclusive receipt creation never retry the same attempt; persist raw execution immediately after the local model returns and write only a redacted terminal failure receipt on later failure. Fail on anything other than five requests, one local batch, exact 96 and 16 unique ranks per request, or zero forbidden counters. Never truncate a target, ownership or attachment proof, complete transformation, partial diagnostic, route, privacy or integrity output.

It neither proves independent R11/03B acceptance nor repairs the five external-required targets or R17 report quality.
